author: simonhac
body:
Stage 9 of config-v4 Phase 14 — the second live v3 render path goes away, and with it the v3 renderer.

## What `/device/{id}` renders now

`app/device/[...slug]/page.tsx` no longer server-builds a transient `DashboardV3`. It calls
**`buildDeviceStrategyDoc(device)`** (`lib/capabilities/server.ts`), which returns a normalized v4
document plus the `dv_` refs it binds, and passes both to `DeviceViewer` → **`<DashboardV4View>`**.

The document is:

```
{version: 4, root: {kind: "group", direction: "column", device: dv_…, children: [ <the strategy group> ]}}
```

`buildAreaStrategy` is unchanged — the device ref goes on the ROOT, and the strategy group inherits it.

## The two questions stage 8's shim left open

**1. The raw `section.areaId` — what is the v4 binding for a device page?**

**`device`, not `area`, and nothing else.** The shim re-derived a synthetic `device-{id}` string because
a device page is not a section over an area; it is a subtree scoped to one device. §8.3 already has a
field for that. Binding `device` gives, exactly:

| | v3 today | v4 now |
| --- | --- | --- |
| card handle | `device.id` (via a fake `ReadableArea`) | `device.id` (inherited `device`) |
| area header | none (`showHeaders = sections.length > 1`) | none (`heading` group, no resolvable area) |
| `chartCapable` | `undefined` | `undefined` (no area to resolve) |
| `section.areaId` | area uuid / `device-{id}` | `""` |
| `oe-grid` pin | `deviceSystemId` on the tile | its own `device` ref, resolved via `resolvedDevices` |

Binding an area instead would have been wrong three ways: it would render an area header the page has
never shown, it would flip `chartCapable` from `undefined` to `false` (same outcome, different reason),
and it has no answer at all for a device whose handle maps to no area.

This needed **one renderer change**: `node-view.tsx` now derives the plugin handle as
`area?.handle ?? device?.systemId ?? null` in both `CardNodeView` and `GroupNodeView`. Area still wins
where both are bound (the v3 rule — `deviceSystemId` was a per-card pin, never the section handle), so
**the stage-5 prop harness does not move**. Without it, every `pending: "host-skeleton"` plugin in a
device-scoped subtree would be gated off by `handle == null` and render nothing. This also closes a
latent gap: a device-bound-only v3-card node on a real dashboard renders nothing on `main` today.

**2. The chart cards' v3 `id` (`chart:lines` / `chart:load` / `chart:generation`) — are React keys stable?**

**Yes.** `normalizeDocV4` mints `n_0, n_1, n_2 …` by pre-order traversal (`v4-validate.ts:209-230`) —
deterministic, not random. The device page's document is a pure function of the device's capability
set, so the same device yields the same ids on every render and every navigation. The stability is
*positional* where v3's was *semantic*, which is the same guarantee v3 actually had for every non-chart
card (`cardKeyV3` fell back to `${type}-${i}`). No remount.

## The `device-` sentinel

**Deleted, and I am confident for three independent reasons.**

1. **The producer is gone.** `app/device/[...slug]/page.tsx:261` was the only one (stage 1's finding).
   It no longer synthesises any `areaId`; `synthSectionV3(undefined)` hands the card `""`.
2. **The removal is behaviour-preserving even so.** `areaRefToArId("")` is `null` — the same "no area"
   outcome the sentinel branch produced by returning `null` directly. The helper-device branch at `:24`
   takes precedence and is untouched, and it is the branch that actually serves this card on `/device`.
3. **It was already unreachable in practice.** On `liveone-dev` all 20 device handles carry an
   `area_id` in `legacy_handles`, helpers included — so `getAreaForDevice` never returned null and the
   sentinel was never produced. (The card's own comment claiming helpers have no area-of-one is stale;
   corrected.)

`grep -rn 'startsWith("device-")' app components lib scripts` → nothing.

## Deletions, with their evidence

| Deleted | Evidence |
| --- | --- |
| `components/Dashboard.tsx` (242 lines) | two importers, both removed here: `DeviceViewer` (ported) and `DashboardClient`'s fallback (below). `grep -rn "components/Dashboard" app components lib scripts` → nothing. |
| `components/dashboard/cards/tiles-card.tsx` + its registry entry | `"tiles"` is absent from `V4_CARD_TYPES`, so `v4CardRenderKind("tiles")` → `"unknown"` → the placeholder. Its only mount was the v3 renderer. `CARD_RENDERERS` is now `satisfies Record<Exclude<DashboardCardType, "tiles">, CardPlugin>` — `"tiles"` stays in `DashboardCardType` because persisted descriptors hold `tiles` cards and `rewriteV3ToV4` reads them. |
| `DashboardClient`'s v3 fallback branch | **Not "unreachable" — reachable only via a corrupt `doc` jsonb.** `dashboards.doc` is NOT NULL and both write paths validate it, so `isDashboardV4` can only fail on corruption. I did not pretend otherwise: the page now falls back to `emptyDashboardV4()` instead. Rendering `descriptor` from a shape-guard failure would serve a second, divergent shape from the column being retired at stages 15/16 — exactly the drift the cutover exists to end. `dashboard.doc` is now a required prop. |

## 🛑 `lib/capabilities/strategy-v3.ts` is NOT deleted — brief correction

The dispatch brief told me to delete it. **It has two live consumers that are stage 13's, not mine:**

- `app/api/areas/[areaId]/default-section/route.ts:37`
- `app/api/dashboards/route.ts:68`

Both call `buildAreaStrategyForHandle`, which is the shim's only entry point. The committed PR-9 brief
(`docs/plans/config-v4-phase14-prs.md:553-605`) does not ask for the deletion, and the shim's own
docstring names all three consumers and says it goes "when the last of them goes". I removed one of
three and updated the docstring to say so. **Stage 13 inherits the deletion**, along with
`lib/capabilities/__tests__/strategy-v3.test.ts`.

## Proof

### 1. A one-shot v3-renderer ↔ v4-renderer equivalence test (commit 1, deleted in commit 2)

`lib/dashboard/__tests__/device-page-equivalence.test.ts` renders **eight** capability shapes through
BOTH renderers and asserts the props are identical — the props each plugin *received*, and the props
each plugin handed its (mocked) leaf. The leaf layer is the gate: the leaves are untouched, so
identical leaf props ⇒ identical pixels. **40/40 green.** Shapes: single-inverter lines; aggregate
stacked-areas; grid context (the `oe-grid` pin); tracked generator; hot-water + renewables; amber
pricing-only; instrumentation-only with the `device-` sentinel; instrumentation-only with generator +
provenance.

Four differences are named and erased from the `renderProps` layer only, never from the leaf layer:
`section.areaId` (uuid → `""`), `section.cards` (pre-existing — `synthSectionV3` always passes `[]`),
`card.id` (`chart:lines` → `n_…`, a React key, with order/arity asserted separately), and
`card.deviceSystemId` (the page device's handle now inherited onto every card; every consumer reads
`card.deviceSystemId ?? handle` and here the two are the same number).

**Proven able to fail**, twice:
- removing the `area?.handle ?? device?.systemId` fallback → **24 of 40 red**;
- withholding the grid device from `deviceById` → **3 red, all in the grid-context case only**.

It is landed as its own commit and deleted with the renderer it compares against — the same discipline
stage 8 used for `strategy-equivalence`.

### 2. Driven in a real browser, before and after, structurally fingerprinted

Eight devices on `liveone-dev`, each rendered at base `7b6e1df2` and again on this branch, fingerprinted
by URL, header-navigator buttons, `<main>` class, the full DOM outline to depth 6 (tag + every class,
path-keyed), `<canvas>` count, `<svg>` count, and digit-normalised `innerText`:

| handle | device | shape exercised |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | Daylesford Selectronic | lines chart + `generator-runs` + tiles, temporal nav |
| 5 | Kinkora Fronius | lines chart + tiles |
